summary: Productivity after Phase 1: every page and dialog of the area works cold (truly cold, with the warm-up off: Focus, Reminders, Routines and its tabs, Calendar, Pacing and the braid, #/tasks), and the boot tickers (reminder, calendar and routine alerts, auto-sync, the review due) run with no page bundle loaded. The Phase 1 features work end to end: the Pacing Shift's two steps and its Undo, row hide/move/reorder, routines inside routines with the mirror and one Undo, per-day routine windows and review times, Skip this showing, Place in a free block and Focus on this, Tomorrow with Undo, the immersion field, the mini player's objective, kept late. Nine findings, no P0 or P1: the row-move toast says 'Moved to undefined' and its hints name the wrong week; hidden plan rows still feed the exam scope and longer reports; reorder and '→ here' have no Undo; a skipped showing still counts down; Simple discards per-day review times; the player cannot finish a routine nested two deep; the Reminders inspector is off screen on iPad; two P3s. November's P1s PR-02 and PR-03 are fixed, and PR-01 (open) is no longer reproducible.

accounts.dense: Pacing (week, braid, Shift both steps, row menu), Focus (set-up, running, mini player, immersion, review), Reminders, Calendar (month/week at six sizes, detail with plan, skip/countdown), Home cards
accounts.sample: Routines (Today, Routines, Templates, History, Settings, editor per-day windows, player, routines in routines), Daily Review afternoon (Time left, Place, Undo), review times per day, Reminders inspector at touch sizes, Tomorrow, truly-cold route sweep, boot tickers

accounts.copy: Not run: the user's backup was not supplied in this batch.

findings.title: Pacing row menu 'Move to previous/next week': the toast reads 'Moved to undefined.' and the hint names a week the row does not go to
findings.detail: Pacing › w/c 2 Nov › In class 'Binary Trees & Graph Traversal' › ⋯. The menu offers 'Move to previous week · w/c 26 Oct — HALF TERM'. Choosing it moves the row to w/c 19 Oct (wb 2026-11-02 → 2026-10-19, wk 9 → 8) and the toast says 'Moved to undefined.' with Undo (Undo works). Reproduced twice on dense at mac. The same mismatch shows for a personal row whose neighbour is a school-only week (w/c 14 Dec, no personal number) or a break. A move that fails ({ok:false}) also toasts 'Moved to undefined.' because the result object is truthy. Should: the hint names the week the row will land in, and the toast names it too.
findings.rootCause: js/modules/pacing.js:1491 and 1507 read res.toWb, but moveEntryWeek returns {ok, prevWb, prevWk, wb, addedWeek} (js/modules/pacing.js:275), so weekAt(undefined) is null; `if (res)` is true for {ok:false}. The hints come from allWks[wkIdx±1] (js/modules/pacing.js:1478-1481), every week including breaks and the other register's weeks, while moveEntryWeek steps through weekListFor(e.source) (js/modules/pacing.js:252).
findings.evidence: eval /tmp rowmove.js on dense mac: items ['Move to previous weekw/c 26 Oct — HALF TERM','Move to next weekw/c 9 Nov',…], after [2026-10-19, 8], toast ['Moved to undefined.\nUndo'], undone [2026-11-02, 9]; /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/productivity/pacing-rowmove-toast-mac-dense.png
findings.fix: Use res.wb and test res.ok; compute each hint from the same list moveEntryWeek uses (export weekListFor or a pure `neighbourWeek(e, ±1)`), and say 'Adds a new week' only when that list ends. Undo of a move that added a week should drop the week again when it is empty.

findings.title: A hidden Pacing row still counts in the exam scope, 'next in pacing', and the month/term/year reports' plan totals
findings.detail: Hide is a soft delete that every derived read must leave out (invariant 84). On dense, hiding personal row p46 ('Programming constructs…', w/c 12 Oct, ref 4.1.1.2, the only row with that ref): carriedInto(23 Nov) drops 25 → 24 and entriesFor leaves it out, but KOS.exams.pacingCovered('2026-11-26','compsci') stays at 52 leaves (the hidden row still puts 4.1.1.2 in an exam's 'covered by the plan' scope) and KOS.exams.nextInPacing('compsci:4.1.1.2') still answers 2026-10-12. A month/term/year report counts hidden personal rows in 'planned' and 'carried' while the week report does not.
findings.rootCause: Readers use KOS.pacing.entries() (every row, hidden included, js/core/pacing.js:621) instead of entriesFor or a filter on hidden: js/core/exams.js:214 (pacingCovered), 602-604 (covered by a ticked row), 611 (nextInPacing); js/core/report.js:1275 (planRows for month/term/year; the week path at 1273 uses entriesFor and skips hidden); js/core/examsession.js:484 and js/modules/examprac.js:614 likewise.
findings.evidence: eval hidden.js on dense: before {cov:52,next:'2026-10-12',carried:25}, hidden {cov:52,next:'2026-10-12',carried:24,entriesFor:false}; js/core/report.js:407-413 (planned = rows.length)
findings.fix: Give KOS.pacing a `visible()` read (entries().filter(e => !e.hidden)) and use it in every reader outside the page (exams.js, report.js, examsession.js, examprac.js, achcatalogue if wanted), or make entries() skip hidden and give the page an includeHidden option.

findings.title: Pacing: 'Move up' / 'Move down' and the carried row's '→ here' write with no Undo, though every U4 row write is meant to have one
findings.detail: Pacing › w/c 23 Nov › CS › My plan › first row ⋯ › Move down: the order changes (Encryption ↔ Hardware) and no toast or Undo appears (#toast empty). A carried row's '→ here' moves it from w/c 12 Oct to w/c 23 Nov and toasts 'Moved into w/c 23 Nov.' with no Undo button. Hide and Move to previous/next week do offer Undo. Reproduced twice each on dense, mac. '→ here' is the more costly one: the row's original week is no longer shown anywhere once it has moved.
findings.rootCause: js/modules/pacing.js:1518-1525 (reorderEntry then redraw, no toast); js/modules/pacing.js:1654-1658 ('→ here': updateEntry({wb}) and a plain toast). Invariant 84: 'each write is one Undo'.
findings.evidence: eval reorder.js (after order swapped, toast ''), undo2.js {hereToast:'Moved into w/c 23 Nov.', hereBtn:false, hereWb:['2026-10-12','2026-11-23']} on dense mac
findings.fix: Toast with Undo on both, as Hide does: reorder Undo = reorderEntry(id, -dir); '→ here' Undo = updateEntry(id, {wb: oldWb}).

findings.title: Calendar countdowns still count down to a showing you skipped ('Skip this showing' is ignored by nextOccurrence)
findings.detail: Make a weekly Deadline due in 2 days (dense, harness), open it, Skip this showing for that date. occursOn(ev, that date) is false and the calendar grid drops it, but nextOccurrence still returns the skipped date, so Countdowns (the Calendar side card, Home, a subject's desk) still say '2 d' to 28 Nov instead of moving to 5 Dec. Opening that countdown row then shows the event as 'Skipped on Sat 28 Nov'. Reproduced twice (eval and again after cleanup).
findings.rootCause: js/modules/calendar.js:444-463 nextOccurrence steps the rule arithmetically and never reads ev.skip or ev.ext.g.skip (occursOn does, js/modules/calendar.js:424-426); deadlines() (js/modules/calendar.js:506) and so countdowns() take its answer. Skip arrived in 1f251ebe (productivity#9).
findings.evidence: eval skipcd.js on dense: {first:'2026-11-28', skip:['2026-11-28'], occursOnSkipped:false, next:'2026-11-28', cd:[['2026-11-28',2]]}
findings.fix: In nextOccurrence, after computing a candidate, advance while the candidate is skipped (loop with occursOn or step again, bounded); the reminders' own nextOccurrence is separate and unaffected.

findings.title: Routines › Settings: switching the three reviews back from 'Per day' to 'Simple' silently overwrites every weekday time with Monday's, with no warning or Undo
findings.detail: Sample account, mac. Routines › Settings › The three reviews › Per day; set Monday morning 06:30 and Tuesday 08:15 (slotTime: Mon 06:30, Tue 08:15, Wed 07:00, so U6 itself works). Press Simple: slots.morning.days is cleared and weekday becomes 06:30, so Tuesday's 08:15 is gone (slotTime Tue → 06:30). No confirm, no toast, no Undo; pressing Per day again rebuilds every day from the new simple times. Reproduced twice.
findings.rootCause: js/modules/routines.js:695-704 (rvModeSeg onclick, the 'simple' branch): nextSlots[s] = {weekday: resolvedSlotDay(s, 1), weekend: resolvedSlotDay(s, 6), days: null}, written by V().setConfig at once.
findings.evidence: eval perday.js on sample mac: slotMon '06:30', slotTue '08:15'; after Simple {weekday:'06:30', tue:'06:30'}, toast ''
findings.fix: When the per-day times differ from what Simple can hold, ask first (KOS.ui.confirm: 'Use Monday's and Saturday's times for every day?') or keep `days` stored and stop reading it while Simple is on; either way give a toast with Undo that restores the previous slots.

findings.title: Routine player drops a run step two levels down, so a routine that runs a routine that runs another can never be finished in the player ('1 of 2 · partial')
findings.detail: Sample account, mac. Routines A (a1, run B), B (b1, run C), C (c1) — all accepted by KOS.routines.check (no loop). Open A's player: it lists 2 steps, 'a1' and '↻ AUDIT B · b1'; B's 'run C' step and C's c1 are missing. Press Done on every step: the player ends on 'AUDIT A · 1 of 2 · partial'; verdicts A 1/2, B 1/2, C 0/1. Ticking A's run step from the Today list instead works (A, B and C all kept), so only the player is wrong. Reproduced twice.
findings.rootCause: js/modules/routineplayer.js:70-77 slots(): an inner routine's steps are flattened one level only and `if (x.checkMorning || x.run) return;` throws away the inner routine's own run steps instead of expanding them (or keeping them as one tickable step).
findings.evidence: eval nest.js on sample mac: side ['a1','↻ AUDIT B','b1'], counter '1/2', after {A:{n:1,of:2}, B:{n:1,of:2}, C:{n:0,of:1}}, doneText 'AUDIT A · 1 of 2 · partial'; /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/productivity/routine-player-nested-mac-sample.png
findings.fix: Make slots() recursive (expand x.run with its own rid and group, guarded by a seen set like runsOf), or keep a nested run step as one step whose Done calls R().tick(x.rid, x.id, true) so tickRun handles the chain; or refuse a nested run in check() if one level is the design.

findings.title: Calendar block's 'This week's plan': the tick boxes shrink to 15–16 px wide beside a long row title, so the column of boxes is ragged
findings.detail: Empty account, iPhone (also mac). Open a weekly CS lesson block on Thu 3 Dec: the My plan rows' checkboxes measure 18x18, 18x18, 15x18, 15x18, 18x18, 16x18, 18x18, 18x18 — every row whose title is ellipsised squeezes its box. Visible as boxes of different widths in the screenshot. Reproduced twice.
findings.rootCause: css/components.css:522 gives .k-check input a size but no flex-shrink: 0; in the .k-cal-plan-row label (css/views/productivity.css:571-573) the long .k-cal-plan-t text takes the space and the input is the item that shrinks.
findings.fix: .k-check input { flex: none; } in components.css (fixes every .k-check row).

findings.title: Shift the plan's summary starts a sentence in lower case when 'Both' or 'In class' is picked ('… adding 2 new weeks. ticked rows, exam-planner rows stay anchored.')
findings.detail: Pacing › Shift plan… › Register Both, 2w: the live summary reads 'Moves 252 unticked rows (In class & My plan) 2 weeks later, stepping over 5 breaks and adding 2 new weeks. ticked rows, exam-planner rows stay anchored.' Same with From this week on. With My plan the list starts with 'In class rows' so it happens to be capitalised. Reproduced twice (dense, mac).
findings.rootCause: js/modules/pacing.js:968-976: the stay list joins lower-case items ('ticked rows', 'exam-planner rows') and only the 'In class rows'/'My plan rows' items are capitalised.
findings.evidence: eval shift1.js on dense mac: summaryBoth and summaryFrom strings above
findings.fix: Capitalise the first item of the joined list (and join the last pair with 'and').

findings.title: Reminders on iPad (both orientations): tapping a reminder opens its inspector below the whole list, off screen, with no scroll to it — the new 'Place in a free block' and 'Focus on this' are out of sight
findings.detail: Sample account (8 reminders), iPad landscape 1180x820 and portrait 820x1180. Tap 'Email Mr Hart…': the row highlights and nothing else visible changes. The inspector is stacked under the list in the middle column; its action row (Place in a free block · Focus on this, productivity#5) sits at y 1659–1703 on ipadl (viewport 820) and 1669–1713 on ipad (viewport 1180), and the page does not scroll. On dense (28 open reminders) it is further down still. Below 860 px (Split View) the inspector is a sheet and works. Reproduced on both sizes, twice.
findings.rootCause: css/views/productivity.css:833-834 (the 1240 tier) turns the three-column .k-rem grid into two and places .k-rem-insp in column 2 after the list, position static; js/modules/reminderspage.js never scrolls the inspector into view or opens it as a sheet at that width (the sheet is only used by the phone tier, css/views/productivity.css:874-876).
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/productivity/rem-insp-ipadl-sample.png, rem-insp-ipad-sample.png; eval rem.insp-actions rect top/bottom 1659/1703 (ipadl, vh 820), 1669/1713 (ipad, vh 1180)
findings.fix: Between 860 and 1240 either keep the inspector as a right column and drop the sidebar to the 'Browse sections' button (as the 860 tier already does), or open the inspector in the same compact sheet the phone uses; at least scrollIntoView the inspector on select.
